46202.market_name: Indianapolis, IN - Near North / Downtown sample
46202.median_home_value_note: Sample market data suggests central Indianapolis has active rental demand from hospitals, universities, and downtown employment.
46202.rent_trend: Moderate rent growth potential, with demand strongest near employment and medical anchors.
46202.home_value_trend: Long-term appreciation assumption should be conservative because submarket performance varies block by block.
46202.property_tax_note: Indiana property taxes vary by county and exemptions. Investor-owned property may not receive owner-occupied deductions.
46202.insurance_risk_note: Typical Midwest insurance considerations; verify roof age, storm history, and replacement cost coverage.

63109.market_name: St. Louis, MO - South City sample

63109.rent_trend: Stable to moderate rent growth; property condition and school/neighborhood boundaries can strongly affect rent.
63109.home_value_trend: Modest appreciation assumptions are more defensible than aggressive growth assumptions.

63109.insurance_risk_note: Older housing stock can create higher maintenance and insurance underwriting questions.
